description: Chart versions are pinned in exactly one place: the root Makefile, as
`<COMPONENT>_VERSION := x.y.z`. The `customManagers` entries below teach Renovate to read
those pins, one entry per pin, each pointed at the registry that actually serves that chart.
Dockerfile base images under `images/**` and the action versions in `.github/workflows/**`
need no custom manager: Renovate's built-in `dockerfile` and `github-actions` managers already
match those paths. The `packageRules` below group their updates.
`customManagers` is the current name for the config key formerly called `regexManagers`; the
old name is no longer present in Renovate's published JSON schema.

customManagers.description: Makefile pin `CNPG_VERSION` -> Helm chart `cloudnative-pg`. datasource=helm because the pin is consumed as `helm upgrade --install cnpg cnpg/cloudnative-pg --version $(CNPG_VERSION)`, so the thing that moves is the chart version. The CloudNative-PG operator image (`ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg:1.2x.y`) and the GitHub release tag use a different numbering than the chart, so docker / github-releases would propose the wrong value.

Makefile pin `SEAWEEDFS_VERSION` -> Helm chart `seaweedfs`. datasource=helm because `--version $(SEAWEEDFS_VERSION)` is a chart version (from https://seaweedfs.github.io/seaweedfs/helm). The chart version happens to equal the app version, but Renovate must look the chart up in the chart repo to get a value the chart repo can actually serve.

Makefile pin `LAKEKEEPER_VERSION` -> Helm chart `lakekeeper` from the chart repo the Makefile adds (`https://lakekeeper.github.io/lakekeeper-charts`). datasource=helm is load-bearing here: chart 0.11.0 ships application 0.12.2, so a docker or github-releases datasource would propose an app version that no chart version exists for.

Makefile pin `OPENFGA_VERSION` -> Helm chart `openfga` from the chart repo the Makefile adds (https://openfga.github.io/helm-charts). datasource=helm because `--version $(OPENFGA_VERSION)` is a chart version. The application tag stays pinned explicitly in helm-values/openfga.yaml on purpose (`v1.14.0`, the version Lakekeeper is tested against), so a chart bump must not move it.

Makefile pin `TRINO_VERSION` -> Helm chart `trino`. datasource=helm because the chart version (1.42.2) is independent of the Trino server release (480) that the chart deploys; the pin must track the chart.
Makefile pin `AIRFLOW_VERSION` -> Helm chart `airflow` from the Apache chart repo (https://airflow.apache.org). datasource=helm because chart 1.21.0 and Airflow 3.2.0 are versioned separately.

Makefile pin `SUPERSET_VERSION` -> Helm chart `superset`. datasource=helm because chart 0.15.5 is unrelated to the Superset image tag (5.0.0) that the companion images/superset/Dockerfile builds on; that image is handled separately by the built-in dockerfile manager.

Keycloak image pin (no chart: manifests/keycloak.yaml + chart/templates/keycloak.yaml). datasource=docker against quay.io because the official image is the thing that moves. The same tag lives in three places that scripts/check-version-parity.sh keeps equal (Makefile `KEYCLOAK_VERSION`, the manifest `image:` line, `identity.keycloak.image.tag` in chart/values.yaml), so all three are matched here and move in one PR.

packageRules.description: Digests in manifests/*.yaml (`image: repo:dev@sha256:…`, rewritten by `make pin`) are owned by Renovate: the built-in kubernetes manager proposes digest updates, grouped here so a digest PR is recognizable and never mixed with chart bumps. Humans do not hand-edit digests; `make pin` output is the cluster truth until Renovate carries it into the repo (#62).
`make install` walks every chart in one pass, so a chart bump is only safe end to end. Group all Helm updates (including the Makefile pins read by the custom managers above) into one PR.
Chart majors routinely rename or drop values keys, which breaks the files in helm-values/. Require an explicit tick on the Dependency Dashboard before a major-chart PR is even opened.
Keycloak majors change realm-import and hostname options; require an explicit tick on the Dependency Dashboard.

Covers the `uses:` versions in .github/workflows/** via Renovate's built-in github-actions manager. Grouped, and rangeStrategy is forced back to `replace` so the major tags this repo uses (`actions/checkout@v4`) are kept instead of being rewritten to exact patch tags.

Covers the `FROM` lines under images/** via Renovate's built-in dockerfile manager. Grouped because the image is rebuilt as a unit; the superset base image is served through the container-registry v2 token flow, so no registry alias is needed.
